interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk on at least one side of the road to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility crosswalk with curb extensions to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a paved, ADA-compliant sidewalk to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or narrow existing lanes to slow traffic and provide space for protected pedestrian infrastructure.

interventions.title: Install New Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a continuous and safe walking path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island in the center median to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees in the buffer zone between the sidewalk and the bike lane to provide shade and create a psychological narrowing effect to slow traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install shorter, more frequent light poles specifically for the sidewalk to improve visibility and security at night.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Install physical barriers such as bollards or a raised curb to separate the bike lane from the travel lane, improving safety for all non-motorized users.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the travel lanes to encourage lower vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to break up the crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Mark a high-visibility crosswalk with appropriate signage to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block pedestrian refuge
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with 'Pedestrian Crossing' signage to alert drivers and provide legal priority for people crossing the street.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at crossing locations to reduce the total crossing distance and make pedestrians more visible to approaching traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a safe walking path.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the number or width of travel lanes to slow vehicle speeds and shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: Install Raised Curbs
interventions.description: Adding a raised curb would provide better physical separation and protection for pedestrians on the walkway.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with pedestrian warning signage to facilitate safe access to the park.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Add speed humps or other vertical deflection measures to slow traffic through this residential corridor.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk and a pedestrian refuge island to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing with RRFB
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk equipped with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with signage and potentially a pedestrian refuge island to facilitate safe crossing between residential areas.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install user-actuated amber LEDs to increase driver awareness at the midblock crossing.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Pedestrian Refuges
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and install a median or refuge islands to simplify pedestrian crossings.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Add signage to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians, especially near the residential complex entrance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and pedestrian crossing signage to formalize the crossing point.

interventions.title: Bicycle Lane Markings
interventions.description: Convert the wide shoulder into a marked bike lane to narrow the perceived travel lanes and provide dedicated space for cyclists.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility markings to facilitate safe crossing for residents.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Introduce traffic calming measures such as speed humps or curb extensions to manage vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Speed Tables
interventions.description: Implement speed tables to physically reduce vehicle speeds in this residential corridor.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with curb ramps and pedestrian warning signs to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant additional street trees within the grass buffer to provide shade and create vertical friction to naturally slow traffic.
